description: Building catalog. Phase 1 = raw-resource extraction (ids 1-33; each now consumes a full, trade-accurate kit of tools/containers that wear a little each cycle). Phase 2 = processing/refining (ids 34-66). Phase 3 = combining/alloying (ids 67-79). Phase 4 = tool & container making (ids 80-130). Phase 5 = weapon & armor smithing (ids 131-153); weapons/armor output in units of 1 while tool inputs wear in sub-units. Phase 6 = vehicle workshops and shipyards (ids 154-156), with output in units of 1. Tool/container quantities (as input wear or output) are in SUB-UNITS (1000 = one physical item); Nails output is in kg. input_job/output_job stay empty until the training phase. production_time is in days; storage_capacity is cm3.
